## Checklist

- [ ] One topic, branched from `main`
- [ ] I read my own diff
- [ ] Built, and ran the tests covering this change (`./scripts/test --filter …`)

- [ ] No cost when unused: no timers, observers, page scripts or web views until the feature is used
